modelCard.target: ArrDel15 (arrival delay of at least 15 minutes)

decisionPolicy.method: maximum F1 on chronological validation split

baselines.uiComparison: calibrated estimate minus training-period network delay rate

historicalRateRanker.definition: mean of the four smoothed carrier, origin, destination, and route delay-rate features

limitations: SkyETA is not live flight status or operational travel advice.
The model is trained on 2025 U.S. domestic carrier records only.
Predictions are estimates for route conditions, not guarantees for a specific flight.
The validation-tuned classification threshold is a diagnostic only; it is not a travel recommendation or live operational alert.
Weather, aircraft rotations, crew constraints, and live disruption data are not included.
